about: Intake-gate specs for the everyday-language queries in retrieval_queries_casual.json, generated by eval/gate_specs.py. Used by `python -m eval.retrieval --queries gate`.

s01.query: I need a little tube to hold a 6mm bolt about one pinkie finger width off the wall.
s01.spec: A cylindrical spacer/standoff sleeve to hold an M6 bolt off a wall. Outer diameter is 12mm, with a 6.5mm diameter through hole centered along its axis to clear a 6mm bolt. The total length (standoff distance) is 12mm (approximate pinkie finger width).
s01.shape: cylindrical tube spacer with axial through-hole

s02.query: A 25mm cube I can thread onto a 10mm rod.
s02.spec: A 25mm cube (25mm x 25mm x 25mm) with a 10.2mm diameter cylindrical through-hole centered on one axis (running all the way through between two opposite faces) to slide onto a 10mm rod.

s03.query: A six-sided chunk like a fat pencil cross-section, 30mm wide and 8mm thick.
s03.spec: A solid regular hexagonal prism measuring 30mm across the flats and 8mm thick.

s04.query: A flat bar about 70 by 20 with a long cutout down the middle, so a bolt can slide along it to adjust things.
s04.spec: A flat rectangular adjustment bar measuring 70mm in length, 20mm in width, and 4mm in thickness. It features a centered through-slot running along its length, 50mm long (overall length with full semicircular ends) and 6.5mm wide, allowing an M6 bolt to slide along it. The slot is centered both lengthwise and widthwise, leaving 10mm of solid material at each end.
s04.shape: flat rectangular bar with a central longitudinal slot

s05.query: Something shaped like a little traffic cone, 40mm across the bottom and 30mm high, solid.
s05.spec: A solid miniature traffic cone with an overall height of 30mm. It features a square base measuring 40mm x 40mm and 3mm thick, with its four vertical corners rounded with a 4mm radius. Centred on the top surface of the base is a conical body tapering from a 26mm diameter at its base to a 6mm diameter at the top, reaching a total height of 30mm above the bottom face (conical section height of 27mm). The top edge of the cone has a small 0.5mm chamfer.
s05.shape: square base plate with rounded corners and a central tapered cone

m01.query: A backing plate to mount a circuit board on, 120 by 80, with six screw holes in two rows and soft corners.
m01.spec: A rectangular circuit board backing plate measuring 120mm long, 80mm wide, and 3mm thick. The four vertical corner edges are rounded with a 5mm fillet radius. The plate features six 3.5mm diameter through-holes arranged in a 3-by-2 grid (two rows along the length, three holes per row). The outer holes are inset 10mm from the length edges (spaced 50mm apart along the 120mm length: at x = -50mm, 0mm, 50mm from center) and inset 10mm from the width edges (spaced 60mm apart along the 80mm width: at y = -30mm, 30mm from center).
m01.shape: rectangular plate with rounded corners and a 3x2 grid of holes

m02.query: A tray for sorting screws, about 100 by 60 and 15 deep, split into two sections.
m02.spec: An open-top rectangular screw sorting tray with overall outer dimensions of 100 mm length, 60 mm width, and 17 mm total height. The outer walls and bottom base are 2 mm thick, providing an interior depth of 15 mm. A 2 mm thick vertical dividing wall runs across the center parallel to the 60 mm width, dividing the interior into two equal compartments, each approximately 47 mm long, 56 mm wide, and 15 mm deep.
m02.shape: an open-top rectangular tray split into two equal compartments by a central divider wall

m03.query: A cap to put on a volume-control shaft, 30mm round; the shaft has one flat side.
m03.spec: A cylindrical volume knob 30mm in outer diameter and 16mm overall height. The top outer edge features a 1.5mm chamfer at 45 degrees. On the top face, an indicator marker line is engraved: a radial groove 1.2mm wide and 1mm deep, extending from a radius of 5mm to 13.5mm. Centred in the flat bottom face is a blind D-shaped socket 11mm deep to fit a standard 6mm D-shaft potentiometer. The socket profile consists of a 6.2mm diameter circle flattened on one side, giving a flat-to-crest dimension of 4.7mm (0.1mm clearance on all sides).
m03.shape: cylindrical knob with top indicator groove and bottom D-shaft socket

m04.query: A round plate 60mm across with a big hole in the middle and eight small screw holes around it.
m04.spec: A circular mounting plate with an outer diameter of 60mm and a thickness of 5mm. It features a central circular through-hole of 25mm diameter and a circular pattern of eight 4mm diameter through-holes evenly spaced on a 45mm diameter bolt circle.
m04.shape: circular plate with central through-hole and radial pattern of screw holes

m05.query: Something to keep six cables lined up neatly along the edge of my desk.
m05.spec: A desktop cable organizer block to hold six cables. The block is 70mm long, 22mm wide, and 12mm tall, with a flat bottom suitable for double-sided tape. Six parallel U-shaped cable channels run across the 22mm width from front to back, open at the top. Each channel is 5mm wide, 8mm deep from the top face, with a full round (2.5mm radius) at the bottom. The six channels are spaced evenly along the length at a 10mm pitch, with channel centerlines at 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60mm from one end (leaving 7.5mm solid walls at the ends and 5mm walls between channels). The four vertical corner edges of the block have a 3mm radius fillet, and the top outer perimeter edges have a 1mm fillet.
m05.shape: rectangular block with six parallel U-shaped cable slots
